messages.subject: Project Sable - exchange arrangements
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

We propose to exchange on Friday 24 October by telephone under Law Society Formula B. Please confirm you hold the signed contract and the deposit of £2,475,000 ready to transfer to our client account on exchange. Completion will be 15 working days later, i.e. 21 November.

Kind regards,
Robert

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert,

Formula B is agreed. We will hold the signed contract and the deposit will be sent on exchange. Our client confirms it is content for you to hold the deposit as agent. Let's speak at 11am on Friday to exchange.

Best,
James
